Signature Edition Tesla Model S Full Walkaround & In-Depth Tour (One of Only 250)

Step inside one of the rarest Teslas ever made — the 2026 Signature Edition Model S Plaid. 

Limited to just 250 units worldwide, this invite-only farewell edition is Tesla’s ultimate send-off to the current-generation Model S.

In this complete guided walkthrough, I show you every exclusive detail that makes this collector’s car special: the stunning Garnet Red paint with matching door handles, 
gold Tesla T badges up front, 
gold Plaid and Signature badging in the rear, 
premium white Alcantara interior with gold piping and gold Plaid seat badges, 
carbon ceramic brakes with gold calipers, 
numbered Signature dashboard plaque (1 of 250), Signature door sills, 
gold puddle lights, 
special interior lighting sequence, 
and the custom Signature key fob.

Key Differences from standard Model S Plaid:

Exclusive Garnet Red exterior color (not available on regular production models)
Unique gold badging, Signature badging, and numbered collector plaque
Upgraded white Alcantara interior with gold piping and accents
Carbon ceramic brakes with gold calipers
Full Luxe Package plus all the limited-edition touches

Original Pricing:
$159,420 (a significant premium over the standard Plaid)Whether you’re a Tesla collector, historian, or just love rare EVs, this deep dive covers why these final 250 Signature Editions are instant future classics.

Elon Musk just confirmed that xAI plans to open-source the current 0.5T Grok foundation model later this year.

That’s the same V8 model currently powering Grok production traffic across X.

Even though xAI is already training much larger next-generation models Elon says the 500B parameter version “should still be quite useful.”

This follows xAI’s growing pattern of releasing older frontier models to the open-source community while pushing internal development further ahead.

For developers this could become one of the most important open AI model releases yet especially for fine-tuning coding workflows and local deployment.

What a wild time to be alive. 

What an insane view of the Starship landing in the Indian Ocean.

Video

Grok’s next major model is getting close.

xAI says the new V9-Medium model with 1.5T parameters has officially finished training and early evals are looking strong.

The current production version of Grok runs on the much smaller 0.5T v8-small model so this is a massive jump in scale.

xAI also confirmed that a large amount of Cursor coding data was added during supplementary training with even more still coming.

Fine-tuning is already underway and reinforcement learning starts within days.

Public release is expected in around 2 to 3 weeks with major improvements expected especially for difficult coding tasks.

🎥 Behind the Scenes at the Tesla Model S & Model X Signature Edition Delivery Event | Fremont Factory

We were invited to the exclusive, invite-only Tesla Signature Edition Delivery Event at the Fremont Factory — the emotional farewell celebration for the final limited run of Model S and Model X.

In this behind-the-scenes video, experience what it was really like: 
• Arriving at the Fremont Factory for this historic send-off 
• The incredible atmosphere as owners took delivery of their ultra-rare Signature Editions 
• Close-up details: Garnet Red paint, gold accents, badging, numbered plaques, and special interior touches 
• Raw, unscripted moments from the event 
• Special highlights where @elonmusk @larsmoravy @woodhaus2 @hrushisagar  shared heartfelt stories about the early days of the Model S and Model X

Only 150 Model S and 100 Model X Signature Editions were ever made — true collector’s cars marking the end of an era for the current generation flagships.

📍 Fremont Factory, California – May 20, 2026
